digest.component_or_area: LLM header delivery and run context interpolation
propositions: Resolved ${run:...} references and configured headers must be delivered via pydantic-ai's ModelSettings.extra_headers to enable gateway attribution and grouping of gate calls.
Header values must be redacted from durable records (verdicts, sidecars, logs) while header names remain visible in provider_provenance for observability.
The extra_headers dict must be freshly copied per call to prevent mutation of the configuration-held mapping and avoid leaking provider version strings into signed verdicts.
Headers attach only when cfg.base_url is set; absent ${run:...} substituends omit the whole header rather than sending empty values to avoid polluting gateway observability.
Unknown ${run:...} keys and values that become unsafe after substitution (containing CR, LF, NUL) must be rejected with clear error messages.
Configured headers must override same-named client defaults (merge precedence) and work across all httpx-based providers without requiring individual transport patches.
